name: F2F TexPro - Sourcing Intelligence Tool
description:
TexPro is Fibre2Fashion’s market intelligence platform for the global textile and apparel supply chain. It provides brands, retailers, manufacturers and traders with data and insights to support sourcing, procurement and market analysis.

The TexPro MCP Server provides MCP-compatible AI assistants with authenticated access to TexPro data. Users can ask questions in natural language and receive structured, source-attributed results that the AI assistant can analyse, summarise or visualise, without the need to export spreadsheets or reconcile data manually.

Data available through the server:
1. Raw material prices across 110+ feedstocks, 170+ fibres and 350+ yarns in 30+ markets, with historical series
2. Import and export trade data from 100+ reporting and 150+ partner countries at HS-code level
3. Country profiles with 40+ economic, production and competitiveness indicators for 50+ manufacturing hubs
4. Financial performance of listed textile, apparel and fashion companies
5. Energy statistics

Example queries:
1. "Compare Indian and Chinese viscose staple fibre prices over the last 12 months."
2. "What duty applies to HS 6109 knitted T-shirts entering the US from Vietnam and Bangladesh?"
3. "Show US cotton yarn imports by source country for the last four quarters."
4. "Benchmark Bangladesh against Vietnam on cost, capacity and trade access for woven outerwear."
5. "Which polyester feedstock prices moved most this week?"

Built for procurement and sourcing managers, commodity and market analysts, supply chain and risk teams, and developers building industry-specific AI workflows. Access requires a valid TexPro subscription, with data access and entitlements determined by the subscriber’s existing plan.

_published_faq.name: How do I add F2F TexPro - Sourcing Intelligence Tool to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add F2F TexPro - Sourcing Intelligence Tool to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.fibre2fashion.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

acceptedAnswer.text: F2F TexPro - Sourcing Intelligence Tool requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops F2F TexPro - Sourcing Intelligence Tool?

acceptedAnswer.text: F2F TexPro - Sourcing Intelligence Tool is developed by Fibre2Fashion. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
